title: Operator rotation playbook, console flags, and orphan-key amnesty
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and implement an operator-first emergency rotation flow and a companion console surface to safely rotate API keys at scale, plus an Amnesty flow for orphaned keys. This work ties RBAC v2 roles, audit logging, and SSO/SAML mappings into token lifecycle controls so rotations are observable, reversible when safe, and auditable for compliance.
background: We currently provide token rotation APIs and manual console controls, but operators lack a coherent playbook for emergency rotations across Dedicated/Private deployments. Audit trails are fragmented between platform logs and customer-managed audit sinks. RBAC v1 conflates owner and operator privileges which complicates operator-led rotations (causes broad blast radius). Customers in regulated industries request a documented, reversible operator rotation workflow and a UI that surfaces orphaned tokens for cleanup with an amnesty period.
proposal: 1) Add an operator-initiated rotation API that creates a parallel key, updates routable scopes, and supports a configurable grace window. 2) Console: 'Rotate Key (Operator)' action with a preview step showing affected services and rollback button. 3) Amnesty flow: flag keys with no recent usage and allow a staged deprecation with notifications before tombstoning. 4) RBAC v2: introduce 'operator.rotate_keys' and 'operator.tombstone_keys' granular permissions scoped to org/project. 5) Ensure every action emits structured audit events (user, role, old_key_id, new_key_id, affected_scopes, reason, correlation_id) and integrates with existing audit log forwarding (Cloud Audit, SIEM). 6) SSO/SAML: map SAML groups to RBAC v2 roles so operators from customer SSO can perform rotations without sharing root credentials.
rollout_plan: MVP API + console flag behind feature-flag 'operator-rotation' in hosted and dedicated
Ship RBAC v2 permission 'operator.rotate_keys' and map internal operator role to it
Emit structured audit events and add correlation_id to trace across services
Beta customers opt-in for amnesty flow; collect feedback for 3 weeks
Full rollout after security review and e2e tests pass; migrate toggles to on by default for enterprise accounts
acceptance_criteria: Operator API can create a rotated key while preserving original key metadata and scopes
Console action shows preview of affected routes and allows 1-click rollback during grace window
Audit logs contain structured event for every rotation with correlation_id and are forwardable to customer sinks
RBAC v2 permissions prevent non-operators from invoking operator-rotation endpoints
Amnesty flow flags keys with no token activity for >180 days and schedules deprecation notifications
E2E tests for rotation, rollback, and tombstone verify traffic routing and backend KV cache invalidation
tasks: Design: UX mockups for operator rotation preview and rollback (DES-2101)
API: implement POST /admin/keys/:id/rotate?operator=true with audit correlation_id
RBAC: add 'operator.rotate_keys' and update policy engine to evaluate action-scoped permissions
Audit: define schema for rotation events and add forwarder hooks to existing audit pipeline
Backend: ensure KV cache warm-up for new key and safe draining for old key during grace window
Migrations: add key metadata fields (rotated_from, rotation_expires_at, tombstone_scheduled_at)
Console: feature-flagged UI with confirmation modal, preview diff, and rollback control
Integrations: map SAML groups -> RBAC v2 roles in identity bridge config
Testing: e2e and chaos tests simulating partial rotation failures and fallback behavior
Docs: internal playbook + public guidance for customers on operator rotations and amnesty
